summary: HOLD before edits: assignment generation 1 has no approved source lease (BaseCommit, TargetRef, SourceRepositoryId, SourceRemote, SourcePushRemote and SourceRef are all null), and the required authoritative cross-device last-tool-activity evidence does not exist in the current runtime. Canonical ReviewAgent contains StateEnteredAtUtc and WorkingTurnStartedAtUtc only (Client/Modules/ReviewWorkflow.fs:86-97), not last tool activity. AgentObservationApi.observe reads getLocalLastSeen and explicitly returns lastSeenProvenance=LocalClientActivityCache or Unknown with lastSeenIsCanonical=false (Client/Modules/OrchestrationApi.fs:2313-2342); its tests assert false (Client.Tests/ReviewWorkflowTests.fs:3546-3550). AgentCommandSurface.md:62-66 explicitly says another client's activity may not be reflected and the cache is not a global heartbeat. Server HubService.GetAgentActivity fails with ActivityProofUnavailable (Server/Services/HubService.fs:129-137); ClientService.RecordAgentActivityForUser sends best-effort cross-device hints only (Server/Services/ClientService.fs:188-218). ActivityLog is a per-device cache, not cross-device authority. AGENTS.md:11 says missing/reset activity data is not proof of inactivity. User dispatch explicitly forbids treating SQLite/ActivityLog/local cache as cross-device authority. CorrectAgentWorkingState itself is present in the MCP surface with git:write and routes through TaskWriteCommand, Client/OrchestrationApi and ReviewWorkflow, so the correction API is available; the missing dependency is authoritative activity evidence, not the correction transition. No files edited, no tests run, no browser schedules recreated, no activation/deployment/restart performed.
